title: Feeding and Mealtime
sub: A student’s eating at school and at home, in four parts: a screen that records the doctor’s and the swallowing clearance, sorts the problem (refusal, or selectivity by type or by texture) and says who leads; a described meal, bite by bite; the foods the student eats now, the target foods and the preferred foods; a plan that starts from mealtime structure and a menu of procedures in which the student can always decline; and one bite-by-bite data sheet with its graph and the student’s weight. It reads the health record from Form DM-1 and sits beside Forms TB-1 (the feeding targets), TD-1 (the protocol cards), HD-1 (home data) and CT-1 (caregiver training).
